Our Revolution supports these candidates

Across the USA, Our Revolution is building a down-ballot bench of progressive champions from city halls to the halls of Congress.  We endorse candidates who are committed to fighting for progressive priorities – issues like Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, and Criminal Justice Reform – and advancing the political revolution!

Please email political@ourrevolution.com for more information!
